subject: The Green Jelly, a single glossy translucent green dome of jelly with bright highlights, resting on the ground
detail: the same figure as its shipped painting; its base stays on one line in every cell so the set anchors on the foot line

poses: idle, a slow squash and stretch about its base that ends where it began
struck, flattening under a blow and springing back to its shape
attacking, rearing tall and lunging toward the viewer, then settling back
